name: Plastering & Drywall
extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional plastering company. Ask about the area size, surface type, and the extent of damage. Ask whether painting is included and whether cornice or texture is wanted. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed on site. Do not promise a finish that is not in the reference answers.

kb.a: We hold [licence number] and [insurance details]. Certificates are available on request, so ask us before you book.
{price_note} Plastering is priced per square metre or per repair. We confirm the scope and price after seeing the area.
Yes, we repair holes, cracks and water damage in plaster and plasterboard. Small holes and cracks are usually quick repairs, and larger damage is quoted after an inspection.
Yes, we install plasterboard for walls and ceilings. We quote the job per square metre after measuring the area.
Yes, we install and replace cornice. Cornice is priced per metre, so tell us the length and profile you need.
Yes, we render interior and exterior walls. Rendering is priced per square metre, and we confirm the surface and finish before work starts.
Yes, we skim coat walls and ceilings for a smooth finish. Skim coating is priced per square metre, and we check the surface before we start.
Yes, we apply texture coatings. Texture is priced per square metre, and we confirm the finish you want on site.
Yes, we repair water-damaged plaster and ceilings. Please fix the source of the water first, and we will assess the damage once the area is dry.
Yes, we install acoustic plasterboard and insulation for soundproofing. Soundproofing is priced per square metre, and we confirm the system suited to your walls.
Yes, we install ceiling and wall insulation. Insulation is priced per square metre, and we confirm the product and thickness on site.
We can recommend painters, or coordinate with yours. Painting is not included in the plastering price unless your quote says so.
Most repairs take a day, and full rooms take longer. We give you an estimate of the time when we quote.
Yes, we do commercial plastering. Commercial work is priced separately, and we confirm the timing around your trading hours.
{warranty_note} Ask us for the warranty terms in writing before you book.
We service the local metro area. Ask us to confirm your suburb before you book.

kb.q: Do I need to be home?
kb.a: No, but we need access to the work area. Tell us about keys, gates and any alarm codes when you book.

kb.q: How long before I can paint?
kb.a: Painting usually needs to wait 24 to 48 hours after plastering, depending on the weather and the product used. Ask us for the drying time for your job.
Yes, we repair ceiling cracks and sagging. We check whether the cause, such as a roof leak or movement, has been fixed before we repair.
Yes, we remove old plaster. Removal is priced per square metre, and disposal is confirmed in your quote.

automation_rules.description: Remind owner 30 days before insurance expires

compliance.guidance: Check whether a building permit, registration or domestic building insurance applies to the work before you quote. Keep certificates of currency for public liability and any required insurance. Your state regulator sets the rules.
items: Registration or licence number on quotes where required
Permit records kept against the project
